calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key WHERE l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test')) AS test_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS helsinki_noncancelled,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS utc_noncancelled,
 COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') AS helsinki_distinct,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line l WHERE l.receipt_id=web_order_id)) AS no_lines,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key WHERE l.receipt_id=web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test')) AS test_orders,
 (SELECT is_trading_day FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date=DATE '2025-12-01') AS trading_day,
 MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order
